Package com.egradx.auth.web

Class EgradxOrganizationMemberProfileController

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.auth.web.EgradxOrganizationMemberProfileController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/egradx/auth/organizations/{organizationId}/users/{userId}/profile") public class EgradxOrganizationMemberProfileController extends Object
The same as EgradxMemberProfileController, with the organization in the URL — for an administrator acting on an organization other than the one their session is in. In practice that is the platform administrator: the guard is the one the rest of /organizations/{organizationId}/** uses, so a tenant administrator can reach only their own organization this way too.

Export and erase are here, and not on the tenant route, because they span every organization the person belongs to: platform-level operations, for a data-protection request that reaches the operator rather than the person.
